ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: A six-membered cyclic transition-state drawing is visible in the figure, with multiple curved arrows inside the ring; the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Three Ar labels are visible in the structure: one at the upper left, one at the upper right, and one at the terminal end of the downward side chain on the right; N is visible at the bottom of the ring, and N is connected downward to Bn. Reasoning: According to the established method, read this figure as a substituted conjugated alkene/imine skeleton, and do not write the curved arrows into the SMILES. Each Ar is expanded as phenyl c1ccccc1, and N-Bn is expanded as N\Cc1ccccc1. Then write according to the SMILES construction path: starting from the left-end constructed benzyl-substituted terminal alkene carbon C(\Cc1ccccc1)=, passing through the central C=C, connecting into the right-side C=C, and then to the C=N imine fragment; the positions of the three Ar groups are each connected to phenyl, and / and \ stereochemical slashes are added according to the relative double-bond/imine configuration shown. Therefore the final SMILES is C(\Cc1ccccc1)=C(/C=C(\C=N\Cc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: Read the structure as a substituted conjugated imine/polyene rather than including the curved arrows. Replace each Ar label with c1ccccc1 and the N-Bn substituent with N\Cc1ccccc1. Trace the carbon skeleton from the benzyl-substituted terminal alkene carbon through the central C=C unit into the side-chain C=C and finally to the imine C=N. Attach phenyl groups at the three Ar-labeled carbons and a benzyl group to the imine nitrogen. Insert stereochemical slashes according to the drawn relative alkene/imine arrangement to obtain the SMILES C(\Cc1ccccc1)=C(/C=C(\C=N\Cc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个六元过渡态样式结构，内部有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头；结构上有三个 Ar 标签，位于左上、右上以及右下侧链末端；底部是 N，N 下方连接 Bn。推理：按方法草案，不把弯箭头写入 SMILES，而把该图读作取代的共轭烯/亚胺骨架。每个 Ar 替换为苯基 c1ccccc1，N-Bn 替换为 N\Cc1ccccc1。从带苄基取代的端烯碳开始，经过中心 C=C，再进入侧链 C=C，最后到 C=N 亚胺；三个 Ar 标记位置分别接苯基，并按图示相对构型加入 / 和 \ 立体斜线。因此得到目标 SMILES。

Ignore electron-flow arrows because they do not add atoms or bonds.
